title: Planetary & Physical-Condition Overlay Library
source_and_design_basis: ENV-01_ENVIRONMENT_MODEL_COMPOSITION_CONTRACT_v1.0.0.md environment property domains and participant-evaluation boundary
ENV-04_OVERLAY_MODEL_v1.0.0.json overlay definition, intensity, relation, effect-key and deterministic-resolution contract
Retained DB-004 exploration/environment framework authority that environments may define gravity, atmosphere, pressure, light and radiation while participant adaptations remain externally owned
library_rules: Physical overlays are reusable environmental deltas, not planet identities or base environment identities.
No universal damage, fatigue, exposure, suffocation, decompression, radiation-dose, carrying-capacity, movement-speed or equipment formulas are invented here.
Species, creatures, characters, vehicles, equipment, powers and adaptations evaluate against the resolved environment through their owning systems.
Stable effect keys deduplicate equivalent contributions under ENV-04; input order never determines the result.
A condition may be intrinsic to a local environment instance or activated as an overlay; ENV-12 does not infer planet-wide scope from a local activation.
Vacuum directly defines its own atmosphere and pressure deltas rather than automatically activating Low Oxygen or Low Pressure as separate overlays.
All ENV-12 definitions are owner-authorized content design and do not claim recovered source text.

overlays.name: Extreme Heat
overlays.applicability: Environment or local scope whose thermal state is materially hotter than its ordinary baseline.

deltas.value_or_reference: extreme-heat thermal regime relative to local baseline
heat-exposure hazard context for participant systems to evaluate
shade, cooling, insulation or protected refuge becomes more consequential
water and heat-sensitive resources may become less reliable where locally supported

overlays.name: Extreme Cold
overlays.applicability: Environment or local scope whose thermal state is materially colder than its ordinary baseline.

deltas.value_or_reference: extreme-cold thermal regime relative to local baseline
cold-exposure hazard context for participant systems to evaluate
insulation, heating or protected refuge becomes more consequential
freezing of exposed water may occur where local material conditions permit

overlays.name: Toxic Atmosphere
overlays.applicability: A gaseous or aerosol atmosphere is present and contains biologically hazardous constituents at locally significant levels.

deltas.value_or_reference: toxic atmospheric constituents present
toxic-atmosphere exposure context for participant systems to evaluate
sealed, filtered or otherwise protected shelter becomes more consequential

overlays.name: Corrosive Atmosphere
overlays.applicability: A gaseous or aerosol atmosphere is present with constituents capable of chemically attacking exposed materials or organisms.

deltas.value_or_reference: corrosive atmospheric constituents present
corrosive-exposure context for participant and equipment systems to evaluate
sealed or resistant shelter becomes more consequential

overlays.name: Low Oxygen
overlays.applicability: An atmosphere or breathable medium is present but has materially reduced oxygen availability relative to an ordinary breathable baseline.

deltas.value_or_reference: reduced oxygen availability
low-oxygen exposure context for participant systems to evaluate

relations.scope: never; reverse relation owned by Vacuum

overlays.name: High Pressure
overlays.applicability: Environment or medium has pressure materially above its ordinary local baseline; pressure kind remains locally qualified.

deltas.value_or_reference: high-pressure regime relative to local baseline
high-pressure exposure context for participant/equipment systems to evaluate
medium-density or pressure-related movement implications remain locally defined

overlays.name: Low Pressure
overlays.applicability: Environment or medium has pressure materially below its ordinary local baseline while still not constituting vacuum.

deltas.value_or_reference: low-pressure regime relative to local baseline
low-pressure exposure context for participant/equipment systems to evaluate
available atmosphere is pressure-limited; composition remains separate

overlays.name: Radiation
overlays.applicability: Environment or local scope contains materially elevated radiation exposure relative to its ordinary baseline.

deltas.value_or_reference: elevated environmental radiation field
radiation-exposure context for participant/equipment systems to evaluate
shielded refuge may become more consequential

overlays.name: Extreme Darkness
overlays.applicability: Ambient illumination is materially below the local environment's ordinary baseline.

deltas.value_or_reference: ambient illumination severely reduced
navigation relying on ordinary visible reference points is complicated
ordinary visual detection context is altered

overlays.name: Extreme Illumination / Glare
overlays.applicability: Ambient or directional illumination is materially above ordinary local levels and causes glare or washout.

deltas.value_or_reference: excessive illumination produces glare, washout or contrast loss
ordinary visual route references may become unreliable under glare
ordinary visual detection context is altered

overlays.name: Low Gravity
overlays.applicability: Effective gravity magnitude is materially below the ordinary local baseline but remains nonzero and directionally stable.

deltas.value_or_reference: low-gravity regime
movement, jumping, traction and inertia are evaluated against reduced gravity by owning systems
gravity-transition and control hazards may exist where local geometry/state supports them

overlays.name: High Gravity
overlays.applicability: Effective gravity magnitude is materially above the ordinary local baseline and directionally stable.

deltas.value_or_reference: high-gravity regime
movement, load, traction and effort are evaluated against increased gravity by owning systems
gravity-transition and control hazards may exist where local geometry/state supports them

overlays.name: Zero Gravity
overlays.applicability: Effective local gravity is negligible for ordinary movement and support behavior.

deltas.value_or_reference: zero-gravity / negligible-effective-gravity regime
ordinary weight-supported movement assumptions do not apply; owning movement/vehicle systems evaluate accordingly
unanchored motion and uncontrolled drift become relevant where local geometry permits

overlays.name: Variable / Directional Gravity
overlays.applicability: Gravity magnitude or direction changes across time, zones or vectors in a manner established by source/local authority.

deltas.value_or_reference: variable or directional gravity regime; exact pattern remains source/local data
movement evaluates against the active gravity vector/magnitude supplied by local authority
abrupt or spatial gravity changes may create transition hazards where locally authored

overlays.name: Vacuum
overlays.applicability: Scope has no meaningful breathable atmosphere and pressure is vacuum-class relative to ordinary atmospheric environments.

deltas.value_or_reference: no meaningful breathable atmosphere
vacuum-class pressure regime
vacuum-exposure context for participant/equipment systems to evaluate
pressure-retaining, atmosphere-providing shelter becomes consequential
